additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
28 main attack damage to universal heroes.
The max-health health regeneration bonus from multiple Hearts of Tarrasque does not stack.
description: Preserved heart of an extinct monster, it bolsters the bearer's fortitude.
trivia: The name "Tarrasque" references the Tarrasque, an almost undefeatable monster in Dungeons & Dragons, which in return references the Tarasque, a mythological dragon-hybrid that was tamed by Saint Martha.

Heart of Tarrasque used to require Ring of Tarrasque to build with the following lore: An ageless ring forged with an otherwise simple blood magic amplified by the presumed source of its key component..
tips: Heart of Tarrasque is effective against teams with a lot of burst damage.
Heart of Tarrasque's strength bonus mostly benefits strength heroes. Agility or Intelligence heroes can consider an Eye of Skadi instead for tankiness.
Later in the game it can replace a magic resistance item.

notes: Multiple instances of Behemoth's Blood do not stack.
abilities.description: Your health regeneration is increased by 1.5% of your missing health.

name: Heart of Tarrasque
